questions.prompt: The Rosetta Stone was key to deciphering which writing system?
questions.fact: The stone repeats the same decree in three scripts, so scholars who could read the Greek were able to work backwards into the hieroglyphs.

questions.prompt: What is the term for an object in space orbiting a planet?
questions.fact: Natural or artificial — the Moon counts too. The first artificial one, Sputnik 1, launched in 1957.

questions.prompt: How many innings are in a standard professional baseball game?
questions.fact: Nine innings and no clock, which is why a game has no fixed length and can run into extra innings.

questions.prompt: Which animated series features a yellow family living in Springfield?
questions.fact: The family was drawn in minutes as filler shorts for another programme before being given a series of their own.

questions.prompt: Which country is known for the fjords along its western coast?
questions.fact: Fjords were carved by glaciers, and these are deep enough that cruise ships sail miles inland between the cliffs.

questions.prompt: Who is credited with inventing the World Wide Web?
questions.fact: He built it at CERN and gave the technology away for free, which is the main reason the web spread as fast as it did.
